name: Minesweeper
description: Classic Minesweeper on your desktop: left click to reveal, right click to flag, double-click a number to chord. Three board sizes, best times and win counts per size, and the game in progress survives restarts.
author: Yacine-DH

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.hint: Changing it starts a new game.

marks.label: Question marks
marks.hint: A third right click puts a ? on a cell.
